summary: The signature the style survey found in 58 files: the whole Verbatim style set is defined and not one paragraph references it. Cites record a card's first and last words with an ellipsis between them, which makes the card ABBREVIATED, not truncated.

paragraphs.text: Data centre demand collapses the reserve margin
